cited_facts.claim: Approximately 98.5% of rural land records have been digitised under DILRMP.
cited_facts.source: Ministry of Rural Development Annual Report 2023-24

cited_facts.claim: More than 3.29 lakh (329,000) villages have been surveyed under SVAMITVA as of March 2024.
Approximately 2.34 crore (23.4 million) property cards have been issued under SVAMITVA as of March 2024.
Land disputes account for roughly two-thirds of pending civil cases in Indian courts.
cited_facts.source: Estimates cited in NITI Aayog and Ministry of Law reports; exact share varies by court and state.

cited_facts.claim: NCR has a population exceeding 5 crore (50 million) and spans parts of Delhi, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan.
